- Implemented gRPC-based service-to-service communication patterns and service mesh integration; authored Linux-based operational runbooks and tooling for cluster diagnostics.
- Led Kafka cluster capacity planning and operational playbooks, including topic partitioning strategies and monitoring, resulting in measurable improvements in resilience and recovery time.
